items.title: Why RSS Still Matters
items.content_html: In an age of algorithmic feeds and walled gardens, RSS remains the only open standard that puts readers in control. No algorithm decides what you see. No company can enshittify your timeline. You subscribe, you read, you move on. The protocol is simple: an XML file at a known URL. Any client can fetch it. No API key, no OAuth dance, no rate limits. This is how the web was supposed to work.
